title: Funds split over many new wallets and brought together again
summary: The funds are split in modest sums over 8 to 30 new wallets across 2 to 14 days. Each wallet then sends what it holds to one wallet.

basis.note: No source read for this design publishes how often a screening tool loses the link at this method. The value is an assumption and means that the trail is lost in 20 cases in 100.

the wallet that brings the funds together

steps.say: The funds are split over many new wallets and then brought together in one wallet.

basis.note: The report describes many new wallets, modest amounts over time and then reconsolidation. The count of wallets and the period are assumed.
